product_overview: ARGUS is a web-based AI debate arena that simulates structured debates between two autonomous agents (Proponent and Opponent) and presents an ML-driven Judge-0 verdict. The frontend is a single-page React app with a marketing landing experience and an interactive debate dashboard.
core_goals: Provide an immersive landing experience that communicates ARGUS capabilities and supported models.
Offer an interactive debate arena where users enter a topic and watch two AI agents argue in turns.
Present automated evaluation via Judge-0 with per-argument scores, fallacy detection, and a final verdict.
Enable clear navigation between marketing content and the debate dashboard while keeping UI interactions responsive and accessible.
Surface known limitations explicitly (static/demo content) to guide future integration of real LLM and ML backends.
